name: GNSS jammer image dataset
integration: Download from the publisher. Keep the official train and test folders separate; use the vision CLI to train ResNet18.
credit: Ruben Morales Ferre, Elena Simona Lohan, Alberto De la Fuente
note: Dataset used by the original jamming notebooks. Consult the publisher for licensing and acquisition details.

name: Raw IQ GNSS jamming recordings
integration: Download from the publisher. Convert a recording to CSV columns I,Q with the correct sample rate; analyze it in Signal Lab. Original archive decoding depends on its file format.
credit: Carolyn J. Swinney and John C. Woods
note: Publisher describes DME, narrowband, AM, chirp, FM and no-jamming recordings. The synthetic pulsed fixture is not an exact DME simulator.

name: GPS spoofing on unmanned aerial systems
integration: Export the labeled spreadsheet to CSV. Import 13 receiver features plus Output or label. Add a group column only when actual capture/session identities are known.
credit: Ghilas Aissou; University of North Dakota
note: Publisher lists CC BY 4.0. Retain attribution. Numeric Output labels are retained without assuming a semantic mapping.

name: Original project research paper
integration: Background reference linked by the original repository; new platform results must be reported separately.
credit: See linked paper for author list
note: Historical notebook scores are not benchmark results for this platform.
